eolis_arms.name: Eolis Arms
eolis_arms.greeting: Steel for the roots, wanderer. Pick what keeps you breathing.

eolis_items.name: Eolis Sundries
eolis_items.greeting: Keys, fruit and dew. All honest, mostly.

apolune_armor.name: Apolune Armory
apolune_armor.greeting: Back from the dark, are we? Then you'll want thicker skin.

apolune_items.name: Apolune Provisions
apolune_items.greeting: The sap's gone hard and so have my prices. Mostly.

forepaw_smith.name: Forepaw Forge
forepaw_smith.greeting: Free hands make good steel. Show me that blade of yours, elf.

eolis_charts.name: Maps and Charts
eolis_charts.greeting: Lost already? Every tunnel I have walked is on these, and a few I only heard about.

forepaw_charts.name: Forepaw Survey
forepaw_charts.greeting: Dwarves chart what they dig. Three years in hiding, and I drew every gallery from memory.
